description: Defines byte-swapping macros and inline functions for 16, 32, and 64-bit values, including constant folding optimizations and pointer-based operations, used for endianness conversions in Linux kernel code.

methods.name: __fswab16
methods.description: Inline function to byteswap 16-bit value, using architecture-specific implementation or constant folding.

methods.name: __fswab32
methods.description: Inline function to byteswap 32-bit value, using architecture-specific implementation or constant folding.

methods.name: __fswab64
methods.description: Inline function to byteswap 64-bit value, using architecture-specific implementation or a combination of 32-bit swaps.

methods.name: __fswahb32
methods.description: Inline function to high/low byte-swap 32-bit value.
